bekker_pressure — DRIVE roverslip op

• 数据种类:signal × scalar × any → signal

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.bekker_pressure(sinkage, width, soil) -> 'np.ndarray'(要直接调用实现,import roverslip; roverslip.bekker_pressure(sinkage, width, soil) -> 'np.ndarray';从台账取用则 opsdrive.get("bekker_pressure"))

用法

Bekker 压力–沉陷关系 p = (k_c / b + k_φ) zⁿ [kPa]。sinkage [m] 为标量或数组(≥ 0)，width = b [m]。
